flashcard_questions.q: Music that is created spontaneously during a performance, rather than being written down in advance.
A six-note scale used in blues and jazz, formed by taking the minor pentatonic scale and adding the flattened 5th.
A group of musicians who play jazz music together, ranging from a small combo (trio or quartet) to a large big band.

flashcard_questions.a: A large jazz ensemble typically featuring sections of saxophones, trumpets, trombones and a rhythm section.
Chords that contain more than three notes, such as 7th, 9th or 13th chords.
